How Pixel-Prize Works

A transparent, two-stage evaluation pipeline combining state-of-the-art vision algorithms with seasoned jury expertise.

01

Create Account

Sign up as a photographer, verify your gear and location, and set up your public portfolio profile.

02

Choose Competition

Browse active contests across landscape, portrait, wildlife, street, and monochrome genres.

03

Upload Photograph

Submit your single best high-res photograph. EXIF camera metadata is automatically validated.

04

AI Vision Evaluation

Our proprietary vision engine analyzes sharpness, exposure fidelity, dynamic range, and generates an initial shortlist.

05

Master Jury Review

Verified industry jurors blind-score shortlisted entries across 5 weighted artistic dimensions.

06

Winners Announced

Official laureates receive cash prize disbursements, prestigious trophies, and permanent Hall of Fame induction.
